title: Signal Architecture v2 — risk bulletins with patch semantics, separate from work lugs
decision: Signals are risk bulletins, not work items. They carry either a JIT patch (apply now, clean up when proper fix lands) or a delivery (lug in an envelope for the spoke's backlog). They live separately from the lug bytype/ tree, have a risk_score instead of ROI, and are auto-applied on wakeup without manual triage.

two_flavors.patch: Carries a minimal JIT fix applied automatically at spoke wakeup. Temporary — cleaned up when the framework delivers the proper fix as a teaching. Applied without user prompt; user notified of what was applied.
two_flavors.delivery: Wraps a ready-to-use lug and drops it into the spoke backlog. No patch, no urgency. 'Here you go.'

signal_schema_v2.risk_score: integer 1-10 (replaces ROI — signals are hazard mitigation not opportunity)
signal_schema_v2.title: string — plain language, describes the risk or what's being delivered
signal_schema_v2.signal: string — full description of the problem or insight
signal_schema_v2.patch: optional object — see patch schema below
signal_schema_v2.delivery_lug: optional object — full lug to drop in backlog (for delivery flavor)
signal_schema_v2.expires_after: optional — ISO timestamp or null (patches without expiry stay until proper fix)

behavioral.instruction: string — plain language directive: 'if X, do Y instead of Z'
behavioral.scope: string — when this applies (e.g. 'during wakeup', 'when creating lugs')

patch_schema.cleanup: string — how to verify/remove when proper fix lands (e.g. 'remove line matching X')

storage.registry: WAI-Spoke/signals/registry.json — lightweight: applied patch IDs + applied_at
storage.hub_inbound: WAI-Hub/signals/incoming/ — signals from spokes awaiting framework processing
storage.not_in_bytype: signals removed from WAI-Spoke/lugs/bytype/signal/ — that was the old model

wakeup_behavior.step: early in session-start.sh, before wai-session-init block
wakeup_behavior.action: read registry.json, apply any unapplied patches, update registry applied_at
wakeup_behavior.notification: SIGNALS: Applied N patches: [id1, id2] — appears in CONTEXT HEALTH if registry non-empty
wakeup_behavior.on_empty_registry: silent — no noise if nothing to apply

hub_to_framework_trigger.sla: within 2 tender cycles of signal arrival
hub_to_framework_trigger.framework_response: implement proper fix → auto-generate teaching → deliver to affected spokes → archive signal

loop_close.action: spoke removes patch from registry, adopts teaching, marks signal processed
loop_close.result: behavioral patch no longer applied — proper fix is now baked in

architecture.score_backlog_change: signals excluded entirely from score_backlog.py — they are not work items

rationale: Current model mixes signals with work lugs (bytype/signal/), gives them ROI scores (wrong mental model), and requires manual triage at wakeup (friction). New model: signals are hazard bulletins that self-apply and self-clean. Spokes stay lean. Framework acts as signal processor. Loop closes automatically when the teaching lands.
migration_notes: Existing signals in bytype/signal/undelivered/ to be triaged: patch flavor → move to signals/inbound/ with new schema; delivery flavor → extract embedded lug, drop in backlog, archive signal. Old bytype/signal/ directories removed after migration.
